mapper.select: select id, request_id as requestId, action, fingerprint, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, actor_member_id as actorMemberId, created_at as createdAt from merchant_desk_receipt where owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_desk_receipt (owner_member_id, request_id, action, fingerprint, target_type, target_id, actor_member_id, created_at) values (#{ownerMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{action}, #{fingerprint}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id as storeId, name, logo, address, location_lat as locationLat, location_lng as locationLng, location_verified as locationVerified, business_time as businessTime, business_status as businessStatus, status, account_status as accountStatus from mms_merchant where id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = 0

select id, merchant_id as storeId, anchor_lat as anchorLat, anchor_lng as anchorLng, radius_m as radiusM, wifi_bssid_hashes as wifiBssidHashes, version, updated_at as updatedAt from merchant_redemption_anchor where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_redemption_anchor (merchant_id, owner_member_id, anchor_lat, anchor_lng, radius_m, wifi_bssid_hashes, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{anchorLat}, #{anchorLng}, #{radiusM}, #{wifiBssidHashes}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select id as productId, product_name as productName, pic, album_pics as albumPics, publish_status as publishStatus, price, original_price as originalPrice, stock, unit, update_time as updateTime from pms_product where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0) order by id desc limit 200

select id as productId, product_name as productName, pic, album_pics as albumPics, publish_status as publishStatus, price, original_price as originalPrice, stock, unit, update_time as updateTime from pms_product where id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0)

select id as productId, product_name as productName, pic, album_pics as albumPics, publish_status as publishStatus, price, original_price as originalPrice, stock, unit from pms_product where id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0) for update
mapper.insert: insert into pms_product (merchant_id, product_name, pic, album_pics, publish_status, sort_id, price, original_price, stock, unit, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{productName}, #{pic}, #{albumPics}, 0, 0, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{unit}, 0, #{actor}, #{now}, #{actor}, #{now})
mapper.update: update pms_product set product_name = #{productName}, pic = #{pic}, album_pics = #{albumPics}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, stock = #{stock}, unit = #{unit}, publish_status = 0, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = #{now} where id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and publish_status <> 1 and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0)

update pms_product set publish_status = 2, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and publish_status = 1 and (del_flag is null or del_flag = 0)
mapper.select: select s.id as skuId, s.product_id as productId, s.sku_name as skuName, s.price, s.original_price as originalPrice, s.stock, s.pic, r.bookable, r.slot_minutes as slotMinutes, r.capacity_per_slot as capacityPerSlot, r.version as ruleVersion from pms_sku s join pms_product p on p.id = s.product_id left join pms_sku_booking_rule r on r.sku_id = s.id and r.merchant_id = p.merchant_id where s.product_id = #{productId} and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = 0) order by s.id

select s.id as skuId, s.product_id as productId, p.publish_status as publishStatus from pms_sku s join pms_product p on p.id = s.product_id where s.id = #{skuId} and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and (p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = 0) for update
mapper.insert: insert into pms_sku (product_id, sku_name, price, original_price, pic, stock, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) select p.id, #{skuName}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{pic}, #{stock}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{actor}, #{now} from pms_product p where p.id = #{productId} and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and p.publish_status <> 1 and (p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = 0)
mapper.select: select id, sku_id as skuId, product_id as productId, bookable, slot_minutes as slotMinutes, capacity_per_slot as capacityPerSlot, version from pms_sku_booking_rule where sku_id = #{skuId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert: insert into pms_sku_booking_rule (sku_id, product_id, merchant_id, bookable, slot_minutes, capacity_per_slot, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{skuId}, #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{bookable}, #{slotMinutes}, #{capacityPerSlot}, 1, #{updatedBy}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: select id as slotId, sku_id as skuId, slot_start as slotStart, slot_end as slotEnd, capacity_total as capacityTotal, capacity_reserved as capacityReserved, status, source_batch as sourceBatch from pms_sku_capacity_slot where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and sku_id = #{skuId} and slot_start >= #{from} and slot_start < #{to} order by slot_start limit 500

select r.id as redemptionId, r.registration_id as registrationId, r.topic_id as topicId, r.chapter_id as chapterId, c.name as chapterName, r.create_time as redeemedAt from redemption r left join cms_topic_chapter c on c.id = r.chapter_id where r.merchant_id = #{ownerMemberId} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.create_time >= #{from} and r.create_time < #{to} order by r.create_time desc limit 200

select o.id as offerId, o.topic_id as topicId, o.chapter_id as chapterId, c.name as chapterName, o.quota_total as quotaTotal, o.quota_used as quotaUsed, o.valid_end as validEnd, (select count(*) from registration_entitlement e where e.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and e.status = 0) as openEntitlements from merchant_chapter_offer o left join cms_topic_chapter c on c.id = o.chapter_id where o.merchant_id = #{ownerMemberId} and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now()) order by o.id desc limit 100

select v.id as reviewId, v.topic_id as topicId, v.risk_type as riskType, v.verification_rate as verificationRate, v.paid_count as paidCount, v.verified_count as verifiedCount, v.one_minute_count as oneMinuteCount, v.status, v.create_time as createTime, v.update_time as updateTime, (select count(*) from verification_review_evidence e where e.review_id = v.id and e.owner_member_id = v.verifier_member_id) as evidenceCount from verification_review v where v.verifier_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and v.status = #{status} order by v.id desc limit 50

select v.id as reviewId, v.topic_id as topicId, v.risk_type as riskType, v.verification_rate as verificationRate, v.paid_count as paidCount, v.verified_count as verifiedCount, v.one_minute_count as oneMinuteCount, v.status, v.create_time as createTime, v.update_time as updateTime from verification_review v where v.id = #{reviewId} and v.verifier_member_id = #{ownerMemberId}
select v.id as reviewId, v.status from verification_review v where v.id = #{reviewId} and v.verifier_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} for update

select id as evidenceId, actor_member_id as actorMemberId, note, media_refs as mediaRefs, created_at as createdAt from verification_review_evidence where review_id = #{reviewId} and owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into verification_review_evidence (review_id, owner_member_id, actor_member_id, note, media_refs, request_id, created_at) select v.id, #{ownerMemberId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{note}, #{mediaRefs}, #{requestId}, #{now} from verification_review v where v.id = #{reviewId} and v.verifier_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and v.status = 0
mapper.select: select settlement_route as route, status, count(*) as claimCount, max(create_time) as lastClaimAt from settlement_claim where beneficiary_role = 'MERCHANT' and beneficiary_id = #{ownerMemberId} group by settlement_route, status

select id as claimId, commercial_context_type as contextType, commercial_context_id as contextId, fulfillment_type as fulfillmentType, fulfillment_id as fulfillmentId, service_unit as serviceUnit, settlement_route as route, source_contract_type as sourceContractType, source_contract_id as sourceContractId, status, create_time as createTime from settlement_claim where beneficiary_role = 'MERCHANT' and beneficiary_id = #{ownerMemberId} and settlement_route = #{route} order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select coalesce(sum(case when claim_id is not null then (case entry_type when 'REVERSAL' then -amount else amount end) else 0 end), 0) as claimedNet, coalesce(sum(case when claim_id is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unclaimedRows, coalesce(sum(case when claim_id is null then (case entry_type when 'REVERSAL' then -amount else amount end) else 0 end), 0) as unclaimedNet from merchant_payable where merchant_member_id = #{ownerMemberId}

select id as batchId, period_ym as periodYm, amount_total as amountTotal, status, invoice_status as invoiceStatus, frozen_reason as frozenReason, frozen_at as frozenAt from merchant_payable_batch where merchant_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and frozen = 1 order by period_ym desc limit 24

select id as batchId, period_ym as periodYm, amount_total as amountTotal, status, invoice_status as invoiceStatus, frozen_reason as frozenReason, frozen_at as frozenAt from merchant_payable_batch where merchant_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and frozen = 1
and (period_ym < #{afterPeriodYm} or (period_ym = #{afterPeriodYm} and id < #{afterBatchId}))
order by period_ym desc, id desc limit 25
